Author: Helen Hancocks
Summary: With bare cupboards and hungry bellies, three cats steal a penguin to catch them fish. A hilarious sequence of events unfolds as the penguin makes his escape, gets mistaken for a nun and a waiter, then finds his way safely home. Meanwhile, the cats are caught for their crime and sent to jail — for a lifetime of gruel. Deftly told and beautifully illustrated by exciting debut author-illustrator Helen Hancocks.

Book Title: Chameleons Are Cool: Read and Wonder
Author: Martin Jenkins, Sue Shields
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Literature & Fiction > Chapter Books & Readers > Beginner Readers
Summary: The ability to change color, a sharp-shooting tongue, and skin covering your eyes — now  that  is cool. Read and Wonder books tell stories, take children on adventures, and reveal how big and WONDER-full the natural world really is. Back matter includes an index.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this children's book informative, telling lots of interesting facts about chameleons, and one customer notes it helps teach fact versus opinion. The illustrations are well-received, with one customer specifically mentioning the colorfully drawn pictures, while another appreciates how it teaches about warm and cool colors. The writing style receives positive feedback for being wonderfully written.
